Confirmed response rate: 60.7% of 61 patients
The response rate is an encouraging early efficacy signal, but comes from a Phase 1/2 open-label study.
Median progression-free survival: 12.8 months
The reported median exceeds one year; the release provides no direct comparator.
12-month overall survival: 76.6%
The survival estimate adds an early signal, but requires confirmation in a larger controlled trial.
Median response duration: 11.1 months
Durability supports further testing; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Phase 3 RASolute 303 is ongoing
The Phase 3 trial will test the regimen against GnP alone and is the next major validation point.
Context by AI Analyst

This is an updated early-stage clinical signal that builds on results presented in April 2026, not a controlled Phase 3 readout. The next catalyst is data from the ongoing Phase 3 RASolute 303 trial comparing RASONQUE, alone or with GnP, against GnP alone.
